note: Triennial election of the fourteen district electoral divisions of Ballycastle rural district, one member each. Nominations were lodged on 7 May 1924: four divisions were contested and the other ten were unopposed returns (Belfast News-Letter, 9 May 1924). The four contests were polled on Thursday 5 June and declared on 6 June. The fourteenth division, Dunseverick, is omitted: the candidate's surname is cut off in the only printed list traced (James M'N...), and is not guessed. Black, the retiring member, 127; M'Dowell (Nationalist), 96; majority 31.

This round was filed as 'Glenariffe', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (glenariffe) answers with a redirect to this one.
